_about: BNPL messaging for c-bnpl (brief §3.7). One line per provider with its mark, shown only when the order total is inside [minTotal, maxTotal]. Templates are the provider's own approved wording; approvedBy/approvedOn stay blank until the current wording is checked against the provider's rules (UK BNPL became FCA-regulated in 2026 — verify the commencement date before launch). {instalment} is computed by ui.bnpl from `parts` (the provider's own split), formatted to the penny. No hand-written instalment maths in copy.

providers.name: Klarna
providers.template: Pay in 3 interest-free payments of {instalment} with Klarna.
